name: MediumFullBodyRoutine

steps.name: Hands Behind Back Chest Opener
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. Interlace fingers behind back, lift arms slightly.

steps.name: Neck Rotations
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. Slowly look left and right, holding at end range.

steps.name: Wrist Flexor Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Arm straight, palm up, gently pull fingers down.

steps.name: Lying Quad Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Lie on side, hold top foot behind glute.

steps.name: Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Half kneel, tuck pelvis, lean slightly forward.

steps.name: Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Pull one arm across your chest with the other.

steps.name: Doorway Pec Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Forearm on doorway, gently turn body away.

steps.name: Seated Figure Four Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Sit, cross ankle over opposite knee, gently press knee down.

steps.name: Child's Pose
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. Kneel, sit back on heels, reach arms forward on floor.

steps.name: Basic Neck Tilt (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Gently pull ear to shoulder.

steps.name: Seated Single Leg Hamstring Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Sit with one leg out, the other tucked in. Reach for toes.

steps.name: Wrist Extensor Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Arm straight, palm down, gently pull fingers towards you.

steps.name: Downward Dog Calf Pumps
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. In downward dog, alternate pressing heels to the floor.

steps.name: Overhead Triceps & Shoulder Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Reach hand down your back, gently press elbow with other hand.

steps.name: Butterfly Stretch
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. Sit, soles of feet together, gently press knees down.

steps.name: Lying Glute Stretch (Supine Pigeon) (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Lie on back, cross ankle over knee, pull bottom leg in.

steps.name: Wall Calf Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Stand facing a wall, one foot back, press heel down.

steps.name: Standing Quad Stretch (Left & Right)
steps.instruction: 30s each side. Stand, hold foot behind glute, keep knees together.

steps.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. On all fours, arch back up, then let belly drop.

steps.name: Standing Forward Fold
steps.instruction: Hold for 60s. Hinge at hips, reaching for the floor with straight legs.

description:
This 20-minute MediumFullBodyRoutine focuses on mobility and recovery.
Stretches included:
- Hands Behind Back Chest Opener (Chest)
- Neck Rotations (Neck)
- Wrist Flexor Stretch (Left & Right) (Forearms & Wrists)
- Lying Quad Stretch (Left & Right) (Quads)
- Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch (Left & Right) (Hips)
- Cross-Body Shoulder Stretch (Left & Right) (Shoulders)
- Doorway Pec Stretch (Left & Right) (Chest)
- Seated Figure Four Stretch (Left & Right) (Glutes)
- Child's Pose (Upper Back / Lats)
- Basic Neck Tilt (Left & Right) (Neck)
- Seated Single Leg Hamstring Stretch (Left & Right) (Hamstrings)
- Wrist Extensor Stretch (Left & Right) (Forearms & Wrists)
- Downward Dog Calf Pumps (Calves)
- Overhead Triceps & Shoulder Stretch (Left & Right) (Shoulders)
- Butterfly Stretch (Hips)
- Lying Glute Stretch (Supine Pigeon) (Left & Right) (Glutes)
- Wall Calf Stretch (Left & Right) (Calves)
- Standing Quad Stretch (Left & Right) (Quads)
- Cat-Cow Stretch (Upper Back / Lats)
- Standing Forward Fold (Hamstrings)
